Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off the procurement review for a pilot with Redwood and need your most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the prior 12-month period. In addition to the report PDF, our auditors ask for a bridge letter if the report coverage doesn't align exactly with our contract dates.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you can share the latest Type II report (PDF) and a short bridge letter (DOCX) if coverage ends before our start date
- Expected turnaround for secure transfer (S3 presigned link, SFTP, or vendor portal)

Thanks,
